items.headline: NVDA stock flattens as retail sentiment turns extremely bearish while Wall Street analysts flag new growth drivers ahead of Q2 earnings next week
Bank of Canada reaffirms Outperform rating for NVIDIA (NVDA)
Multiple analysts reiterate bullish ratings and highlight CPU and data center growth drivers for NVIDIA ahead of its August 26 Q2 earnings report and $91B revenue guidance
NVIDIA announces multi-year partnership with SB Energy to develop large-scale AI data center campus at PORTS Technology Campus in Ohio
NVIDIA partners with major Wall Street institutions on financing platforms targeting over $500 billion for AI infrastructure, potentially backed by up to $125 billion from NVIDIA
